mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST exceeds 1000 and RSAFS exceeds 400000, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 240) signals elevated risk of aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 240, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above 100 indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A very low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals an overheating labor market that may trigger wage inflation and monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST > 1000) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 240) indicates an overheating economy that increases monetary tightening probability, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST exceeds 1000 and CPIAUCSL exceeds 240, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During strong industrial expansion (INDPRO > 105), manufacturing output growth supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.
